title: BUILD-GV2-033-methodology-question-triage-flow
universal_lens: The methodology triage flow defines a constrained state-transition system over inquiry manifolds. By mapping user queries to categorical support buckets while strictly isolating proprietary kernels, the architecture enforces an information-theoretic boundary. This structural unification minimizes epistemic leakage and optimizes operational leverage through deterministic routing protocols.
gsi_mapping: Within GSI, the triage flow acts as a conformal filter on incoming query streams. It assigns nonconformity scores to distinguish standard support from high-value methodological inquiries. Bayesian priors update retention probabilities based on safe, bounded responses, ensuring customer trust remains robust without exposing underlying predictive edge models.
gse_mapping: For GSE situational reasoning, this primitive establishes a guarded state machine. Incoming user intents trigger transitions between 'public assistance' and 'restricted methodology' states. The engine evaluates contextual embeddings against a strict safety manifold, executing zero-leakage fallbacks to preserve competitive advantage while maintaining engagement continuity.

primitives.name: Methodology Leakage Guard Operator
primitives.verbatim_quote: ## Copy / Brand Voice Needed Plain human copy, no fake certainty, no pressure, no method leakage, no irresponsible gambling language, and clear disclosure where required.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: L: Leakage probability (dimensionless, [0,1]); C: Copy compliance score (dimensionless); D: Disclosure requirement flag (boolean).

primitives.breakdown_regime: Fails when adversarial prompt injection forces the LLM to bypass safety constraints, or when ambiguous queries blur the boundary between general advice and proprietary methodology.

primitives.name: Production Isolation Boundary Condition
primitives.verbatim_quote: Stop before production data, public launch, live affiliate links, billing, or deploy.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: S_dev: Development environment state (dimensionless); S_prod: Production environment state (dimensionless); Delta: Coupling coefficient (must equal 0).
primitives.assumptions: Development and production environments are topologically distinct; changes in development do not induce mutations in production until explicit approval gates are crossed.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Breaks if environment variables leak across boundaries, or if a developer accidentally commits live secrets, collapsing the isolation barrier.

layer2.mapping: Represents a Dirichlet boundary condition in the deployment pipeline graph, enforcing zero-flux of state mutations from the experimental node to the live revenue node.
layer2.telemetry: Number of unauthorized production touches; frequency of rollback events triggered by boundary violations.

primitives.name: Triage Topology Mapper
primitives.verbatim_quote: ## Product Surface help ## Internal Surface support ## Customer Value Users get clearer, safer, more useful sports intelligence with less confusion and more trust.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: Q: User query vector; T: Triage category label; R: Routing destination (enum: product_help, internal_support).
primitives.assumptions: The space of user questions is partitionable into disjoint sets corresponding to surface-level product friction versus deep internal support needs.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Degenerates when query semantics are highly entangled, making it impossible to cleanly separate product UI confusion from genuine methodological curiosity.

layer2.mapping: Maps the continuous embedding space of user queries to a discrete categorical lattice, optimizing for minimal cross-talk between the 'Product Surface' and 'Internal Surface' nodes.
layer2.telemetry: Precision and recall of automated ticket categorization; reduction in mean time to resolution for routed tickets.
